derivations.claim: The identity phi(z)-phi(-z)=z does not guarantee a useful half-linear sparse decomposition.
assumptions: Real tanh-GELU
Drop the even remainder while keeping z/2

At large negative z, phi(z) approaches0 while z/2 and its even remainder cancel.

derivations.scope: Counterexample to a universal usefulness guarantee.
derivations.implication: Reject blind half-slope deployment; calibrate against actual post-Q2 activations.

novelty.mechanism_link: Independent construction was recorded before prior-art search. Signed native compensated-risk routing is a conditional research candidate, not a proven new invention. Full affine fold plus sparse correction substantially overlaps TARDIS and is treated as transfer.

nearest_prior_art.comparison: Jointly trained step structures and fake-score output rollout; distinct from frozen-model offline evaluation.
UB1 already implements step-specific static packing with residual correction; mandatory strong baseline.

TARDIS already folds linear FFN approximations and selectively restores nonlinear outputs. R2 does not claim this operator as novel; Wan QDQ, fixed64-group budget and folding numerics require separate evidence.
PrunePath is a structured routed FFN precedent; generic routing/budget control is not novel. It does not establish the proposed frozen-Wan compensated signed-risk mechanism.
Per-block recoverability is heterogeneous in studied language models. Provides no Wan-specific linearity guarantee.

decisions.reason: Scoped algebra and cost constraints resolved under stated assumptions.
Use latest UB1/UB2/AR2/OD1 results; replace generic dense scan and small-rank replay with one frozen-baseline diagnostic.
E1 remains planned; user requested deduction first, not a fresh GPU run.
Exact identities and counterexamples eliminate invalid general guarantees without model experiments.
Change selection target to conditional signed native loss advantage; keep existing cost-constrained features and compare with best static supports.
Reject blind half-linear GELU. Use calibrated post-Q2 affine decomposition only as a lower-priority known-operator transfer with explicit native discrepancy.
